trigger_condition.shape_trigger: out view shape smaller than computed output shape
trigger_condition.memory_trigger: out tensor is a view whose backing storage is smaller than the resized output requires
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: out must be an undersized view; required output shape larger than allocated view storage; implicit resize only changes metadata

bug_oracle.description: Kernel writes beyond the view's allocated storage and corrupts adjacent memory.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Vary output shape and view size so the out view is smaller than the required result shape.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Create base storage tensors and derive views with controlled offsets and lengths.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Pass out= views that require implicit resizing without being able to reallocate storage.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Allocate base storage -> create undersized view -> call torch.add(a, b, out=view) with output shape exceeding view storage.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Use ASan or guard/sentinel regions around storage to detect writes beyond the view allocation.
